title: The no-call, then the suspension
summary: A disputed third-down non-call was followed by an official’s confrontation with Trey McBride. The NFL subsequently suspended line judge Jeff Seeman for two games.

timeline.label: Fourth quarter
timeline.text: Contact on McBride’s third-and-2 target did not draw a pass-interference or illegal-contact flag.

timeline.label: After the play
timeline.text: Video captured an exchange between McBride and Seeman.

timeline.label: October 5
timeline.text: The league announced a two-game suspension for unprofessional conduct.

unusual: The league’s disciplinary action is established. It addresses conduct toward a player, rather than proving that the underlying coverage ruling was deliberately wrong.
explanations: A heated exchange following a contested call explains the investigation. Intentional manipulation is unsupported.
questions: The discipline announcement does not supply a formal correction of the non-call.
